en: Maximum frames per second. VSync and hardware may keep the actual frame rate lower.

Original uses the original scene. Painted ground adds painted terrain with original creatures, props and lighting. Full painted also changes foliage, sky and scene colors. Overhead text stays crisp in every mode. Takes effect at once.
Controls character model LODs, actor shadows, remote cape cloth, world shadows and painted effects. Low favors crowded scenes; High keeps full detail. Takes effect at once.
Set by {variable} for this session. Your own choice is kept for when it is not set.
How far away names, titles and health bars still show. Whoever you are fighting keeps theirs at any range.
Keep the combat box on screen
Keep the camera on the player
These are the server's settings. Choosing one sends the command; the server decides.
Repeat attack spells every combat round

Off: each target spell is one click. On: after you click a creature with an attack spell, it is cast again every two seconds until you click elsewhere, press Escape, run out of ether or reagents, or the target falls.
Press a key for {action}, or Escape to keep it.
Keys are saved in keys.ini in the game's user folder, one #K_ line per action, the way Eternal Lands keeps key.ini.
